record.oneLiner: LiveAgent is a helpdesk and live chat software featuring a comprehensive REST API (v3) authenticated via API keys, and an official built-in MCP server for AI tool integrations.
record.verdictReason: LiveAgent provides public API v3 documentation along with self-serve free trial registration and API key generation. Furthermore, the vendor officially provides a built-in MCP server.

evidence.quote: What is an API key API key is an identity of your LiveAgent (like your username and password) which you can use to build your own custom integration solutions.
1. Consider registering a new free Trial account for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.

LiveAgent exposes a built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that lets you connect external AI tools — such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, claude.ai, FlowHunt, or any other MCP-compatible client — directly to your LiveAgent account.
